conclusion: The four encrypted chunks under the pinned prefix are present in alice-xfer and are byte-identical to the local copies, which decrypt to a tarball whose sha256 equals EXPECTED_SHA in scripts/awsless/modal/alice_runtime.py. No rebuild is required. The runtime sha gate at alice_runtime.py line 311 will pass against the objects currently in the bucket.
shaSemantics: EXPECTED_SHA is the sha256 of the DECRYPTED tarball (alice.tar.gz), not of any single R2 object. The R2 objects are aes-256-cbc ciphertext split into 4 parts. No individual object sha256 can equal EXPECTED_SHA by construction.

verificationMethod.summary: Verified without downloading the 1.03 GB payload, by combining an R2 ETag comparison with a local decrypt.
steps: 1. Listed the prefix over the R2 S3-compatible API (endpoint https://036df6c823669b8fa2f66cf4c16eeb29.r2.cloudflarestorage.com, bucket alice-xfer). Four objects returned, sizes and LastModified as recorded above.
2. Each returned ETag is a bare 32-hex value with no multipart -N suffix, so for these single-part uploads the ETag is the MD5 of the stored object.
3. Computed MD5 of the four local files in 555stream/.secrets/alice-artifact-livefix-20260723/. All four equal the corresponding R2 ETags, so the stored bytes are identical to the local bytes.

4. Concatenated the four local parts and streamed them through openssl enc -d -aes-256-cbc using the keyHex/ivHex from the local gitignored alice-artifact-meta.json, then sha256 of the plaintext tarball. Result: e7bb0b0d94bf65428241facfa40c45506af6fc2a29f8f6cbc9335fcc32eae6fe, equal to EXPECTED_SHA.
5. Steps 3 and 4 together establish that the objects in the bucket decrypt to the tarball the runtime expects.
verificationMethod.r2Auth: Account-scoped Cloudflare API token at ~/.sw4p-cf/r2-token, verified via /accounts/{id}/tokens/verify (status active). S3 access key id is the token id; secret is the sha256 of the token value. No token or key material was printed or stored.

localSources.note: Both files hold secret key material, are gitignored, and their contents are not reproduced here. Only their existence and the derived sha256 are recorded.

runbookCaveatResolved.caveat: HANDOVER-alice-resume-2026-07-27.md section 2 Step 0 states that no local artifact meta carries the e7bb0b0d sha and that a rebuild should be assumed.
runbookCaveatResolved.finding: That scan was scoped to the 16 metas under 555/.alice-tmp/ and missed 555stream/.secrets/. The livefix meta there carries exactly this sha and its encBytes of 1034092384 equals the sum of the four R2 object sizes.
runbookCaveatResolved.effect: The rebuild assumption is lifted. Neither a rebuild nor fresh key material is needed for a restore.
